comparison.objective: Safely mount a grinding wheel and its flange/blotter stack on a grinder spindle.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspect/select parts, align and stack them on a spindle, thread and appropriately tighten a nut.
comparison.success_condition: Correct undamaged wheel and ordered stack are secured without under- or overtightening; spindle lock is released and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Spindle stacking and torque control do not require maintaining a flush rail–jig bridge or containing free rolling elements during a sliding transfer. No missing rubric detail prevents distinction.
